metadata.title: Tidal disruption events from supermassive black hole binaries

notes: The paper studies generic tidally disrupted stars and hydrodynamical simulations of their debris in supermassive-black-hole binaries; it does not identify any individual star or establish any as a Galactic unbound candidate. Its uses of “unbound” refer to stars or debris unbound from the binary/SMBHs, not to stars unbound from the Milky Way. SDSS J120136.02+300305.5 is mentioned only as a galaxy with a previously discussed TDE, not as an eligible star.
